mathematics.conventions: Compressed index starts at zero; reciprocal ordinary degree N*n; least nonnegative residues; second differences undefined before index two; adjacent-residue points need the next integer-valued sample; query signs retained. Discovery matches every usable transformed input term, at least six, against contiguous stored samples; multiple target positions are grouped. Binomial transforms sum from k=0 to n; inverse sign is (-1)^(n-k).
